title: The Predictive Approaches to Treatment effect Heterogeneity (PATH) Statement: Explanation and Elaboration

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《The Predictive Approaches to Treatment effect Heterogeneity (PATH) Statement: Explanation and Elaboration》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The PATH (Predictive Approaches to Treatment effect Heterogeneity) Statement was developed to promote the conduct of, and provide guidance for, predictive analyses of heterogeneity of treatment effects (HTE) in clinical trials.

evidence.text: The PATH (Predictive Approaches to Treatment effect Heterogeneity) Statement was developed to promote the conduct of, and provide guidance for, predictive analyses of heterogeneity of treatment effects (HTE) in clinical trials.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《The Predictive Approaches to Treatment effect Heterogeneity (PATH) Statement: Explanation and Elaboration》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】The goal of predictive HTE analysis is to provide patient-centered estimates of outcome risk with versus without the intervention, taking into account all relevant patient attributes simultaneously, to support more personalized clinical decision making than can be made on the basis of only an overall average treatment effect.
